reason: SMOKE-BACKOFF (PADRAO-DEV F8b): no pause runs between reads of a state. The readiness wait is the port's: GET /v1/health?wait_s=<what is left of the (DEPLOY_SMOKE_TRIES - 1) x DEPLOY_SMOKE_SLEEP window, 25 s>, which http_port.ready holds until the database answers and marks (long_poll; live since 1d5693e, proved by a read of the live port on 18/11), and a marked answer that is not ok yet is asked again at once. The sleep the scan finds runs only after an answer that is not a pass and that the port did not hold: a failed request (no answer, the gateway's 5xx or 429, a refusal or a wrong body of the two status checks, which run once the health is ready and ask no state that is expected to change), and an unmarked health answer of a port older than PORT-HEALTH-WAIT (said; no deploy serves one since last-sha passed 1d5693e, and it is retried as an unready port was so a port ready in time stays green). Its delay grows: 1 s, doubling up to DEPLOY_SMOKE_SLEEP (never longer than the old fixed pause), back to 1 s after a held answer, and cut at the window's end on a millisecond clock, so the last ask is at that end and red comes once the window is over: never before it (SECONDS could end it up to 1 s early, so the clock is date's), never later than the old retry every pause.
